claims.text: Reviewers with curly and coily hair (including 4c) report that the products leave their hair soft, moisturized, and manageable.
Many reviewers praise the 3 Minute Miracle deep conditioner as especially effective, including for damaged or dry hair.
Several reviewers highlight the good value and pleasant scent of the products.
Some reviewers note the shampoo can feel stripping or leave hair feeling hard, though the conditioner restores moisture.
A few reviewers report receiving the wrong product or an incomplete order.
